_meta.noteSi: Današnje stavbe: uradni GURS eZKN obrisi (WFS SI.GURS.KN:STAVBE, posnetek 2026-10-13, KO 1544 GRIBLJE + KO 1552 ADLEŠIČI južni bbox; recept scripts/p48_fetch_stavbe.sh). Lokalni koordinati: toLocal() izv. village3d.ts (izhodišče 45.5725 N 15.2926 E — sodobno jedro vasi, OSM place node). Stavbe 1825: list A02 po GEOTRUTH afini (issue #14) — cerkev na uradnem EŠD 2122, struga Kolpe potrjena 6–30 m. NADGRADNJA P16: OSM posnetek (15/26/115, pokrival le jedro) → uradni GURS obrisi (P54) — popolna pokritost katastra, vključno z zahodnimi pobočji.
_meta.noteEn: Present-day buildings: official GURS eZKN footprints (WFS SI.GURS.KN:STAVBE, snapshot 2026-10-13, KO 1544 GRIBLJE + KO 1552 ADLEŠIČI south bbox; receipt scripts/p48_fetch_stavbe.sh). Local coords via toLocal() of village3d.ts (origin = modern village centre, OSM place node). 1825 buildings: sheet A02 under the GEOTRUTH affine (issue #14) — church anchored to the official EŠD 2122, Kolpa channel confirmed at 6–30 m. P16 UPGRADE: OSM snapshot (15/26/115, covered the core only) → official GURS footprints (P54) — complete cadastral coverage, western slopes included.
_meta.methodSi: Težiščna primerjava 156 katastrskih stavb 1825 (list A02, GEOTRUTH) z uradnimi GURS eZKN obrisi (EPSG:3794 → WGS84 pyproj always_xy, enako P47/P48) v oknu bbox(350 OSM) ∪ bbox(156 tlorisov) ± 50 m. Pravila P16, kalibrirana z replajo na starih OSM podatkih (156/156): OBSTOJA: d ≤ 8 m ali (d ≤ 20 m in prekrivanje tlorisa ≥ 0,10); NEGOTOVO: stavba v 40 m; NI JE VEČ: brez stavbe v 40 m — odsotnost stavbe NI dokaz porušitve, terenska preverba čaka. d = težišče tlorisa ↔ težišče obrisa; prekrivanje = presek pravokotnikov / ploščina tlorisa. Od P54 je d zapisan za VSE tlorise (P16 le do ~117 m), ker UI prikazuje razdaljo tudi rdečim duhovom.
_meta.methodEn: Centroid comparison of 156 cadastre buildings of 1825 (sheet A02, GEOTRUTH) against official GURS eZKN footprints (EPSG:3794 → WGS84 pyproj always_xy, as P47/P48) within the window bbox(350 OSM) ∪ bbox(156 footprints) ± 50 m. P16 rules, calibrated by replay on the old OSM data (156/156): EXISTS: d ≤ 8 m or (d ≤ 20 m and footprint overlap ≥ 0.10); UNCERTAIN: a building within 40 m; GONE: no building within 40 m — absence is NOT proof of demolition, field check pending. d = footprint centroid ↔ outline centroid; overlap = rectangle intersection / footprint area. Since P54, d is recorded for ALL footprints (P16 only up to ~117 m) because the UI shows the distance to red ghosts as well.
_meta.transform: EPSG:3794 → WGS84 (pyproj always_xy) → toLocal() izv. village3d.ts
